acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

For targeted analysis of PLIN2 and PLIN5 in human skeletal muscle, the instrument was operated in parallel reaction monitoring (PRM) mode using an Ultimate 3000 RSLCTM nano system (Thermo Scientific) coupled to a Q‐Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins were incubated at 37°C for 15 min in UA buffer containing 100 mM dithiothreitol followed by incubation (20 min at 4°C) protected from light in UA buffer containing 50 mM iodoacetamide.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins were incubated at 37°C for 15 min in UA buffer containing 100 mM dithiothreitol followed by incubation (20 min at 4°C) protected from light in UA buffer containing 50 mM iodoacetamide.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Tryptic digestion was performed using the filter‐aided sample preparation (FASP) method.

collision_energy.evidence: MS/MS data were acquired using quadrupole ion selection with a 3.0 m/z window, HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 30 and in the orbitrap analyzer at 17 500‐resolution at m/z 200 (AGC target 5e4 ion with a maximum fill time of 80 ms).

Untargeted MS/MS analysis of peptides were acquired via HCD fragmentation mode (normalized collision energy 27) and detection in the Orbitrap (70 000 resolution at m/z 200, 5e4 automatic gain control (AGC), 240 ms maximum injection time, and 2 m/z isolation window) and a 30 s dynamic exclusion window was used to avoid repeated selection of peptides for MS/MS analysis.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS/MS data were acquired using quadrupole ion selection with a 3.0 m/z window, HCD fragmentation with a normalized collision energy of 30 and in the orbitrap analyzer at 17 500‐resolution at m/z 200 (AGC target 5e4 ion with a maximum fill time of 80 ms).

labeling.evidence: Stable isotopically‐labeled (SIL) peptides corresponding to the targeted endogenous peptides were spiked in each sample as a 1 fmol/μL concentration and 0.5 fmol/μL for PLIN2 and PLIN5, respectively (HeavyPeptideTM AQUA Basic).

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: Peptide mixtures were analyzed using an Ultimate 3000 RSLC nano liquid chromatography system (Thermo Scientific) coupled to Q‐Exactive orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
